author: Mark Atwood
text: Landed by worker7 (commits 78d052eb0b, f502605202 on beads-worker-7): (a) lichen/apps/puck/prj.conf now pins CONFIG_NET_IPV6_MLD=y with an R-12-036 comment; puck native_sim/native/64 rebuilt green with CONFIG_NET_IPV6_MLD=y confirmed in .config (needs -DLICHEN_TIME_BUILD_EPOCH_MODE=developer-generated -DLICHEN_DEVELOPER_BUILD_EPOCH_UNIX=<n> in this tree, unrelated to MLD). (b) New ztest lichen/tests/sos_mcast_membership (native_sim/native/64): dummy-NIC interface whose L2 advertises NET_L2_MULTICAST; asserts ff02::1 all-nodes membership via net_if_ipv6_maddr_lookup after a unicast IPv6 addr add. TWO variants in testcase.yaml: mld_on (MLD=y -> must be joined) and mld_off (MLD=n + CONFIG_NET_TEST=y -> must NOT be joined; NET_TEST required because NET_IPV6_ND 'select NET_IPV6_MLD if !NET_TEST' silently reverts MLD=n - caught by reviewer pass 3, first mld_off binary wrongly ran the mld_on assertions; fixed and verified at .config + autoconf.h + runtime level). Both variants PASS. (c) Decision: no Kconfig-gated explicit join needed - MLD stays on by design (lichen_l2_init.c comment: LICHEN uses standard ND/MLD for all-nodes; t_echo conf: DAD/MLD stay ENABLED); MLD report traffic is one report to ff02::16 per group join, acceptable on broadcast LoRa per the existing L2 design comments. CoAP sos_post handler unchanged (transport-agnostic as investigated). Residual: full end-to-end POST-delivery proof filed as follow-up (sos_mcast_membership E2E bead). NOTE: twister on this box drops prj.conf (existing suites affected too) - tests were run via plain west build; env bug filed. Reviews: 4 kimi-k3 passes (correctness PASS, security PASS, edge-cases found the mld_off P0 -> fixed, convergence re-review PASS).
